description: This file contains a SwiftUI extension for 'OnboardingView' that defines various onboarding pages and UI components for the OpenClaw macOS app, including welcome, connection setup, permissions, CLI installation, workspace configuration, onboarding chat, and completion steps.

classes.name: OnboardingView
classes.description: An extension providing various SwiftUI view functions for onboarding pages of the OpenClaw app.

methods.name: pageView
methods.description: Selects and displays the appropriate onboarding page based on page index.

methods.name: welcomePage
methods.description: Displays the welcome page with security notices and introductory information.

methods.name: connectionPage
methods.description: Provides UI for selecting and configuring Gateway connection options.

methods.name: permissionsPage
methods.description: Displays permission requests for macOS capabilities needed by the app.

methods.name: cliPage
methods.description: Guides the user through installing and verifying the CLI tool.

methods.name: workspacePage
methods.description: Instructions for setting up or creating an agent workspace.

methods.name: onboardingChatPage
methods.description: Shows a dedicated onboarding chat with the agent.

methods.name: readyPage
methods.description: Final step indicating onboarding completion and offering next actions.

methods.name: probeRemoteConnection
methods.description: Asynchronously checks connectivity with the remote gateway.

methods.name: resetRemoteProbeFeedback
methods.description: Resets remote connection probe status indicators.
